name: hdbt
description: Theme builder configuration for HDBT Drupal 10 theme
author: Druid

scripts.build: npm run format:js --loglevel=silent && npm run lint -s && npm run validate-ts && node theme-builder.mjs
scripts.lint:scss: npx postcss "src/scss/**/*.scss" --syntax postcss-scss --use css-declaration-sorter --replace --no-map && npm run lint:stylelint

@comment dependencies: The following packages were updated manually.
Remove this section once the dependencies have been updated in their respective upstream packages.

@comment dependencies.backstopjs > puppeteer: >=25.0.8, Backstop depends on a vulnerable version of puppeteer
@comment dependencies.postcss: >=8.5.18, dependency of hds-react; fixes path traversal via sourceMappingURL (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849)
@comment dependencies.qs: ^6.16.0, dependency of express and body-parser via backstopjs; no fixed express 4.x or body-parser 1.x release exists (GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g)
@comment dependencies.test-exclude: ^8.0.0, dependency of @vitest/coverage-v8; drops the deprecated glob 10
@comment dependencies.@react-spring/* and react-popper: $react, dependencies of hds-react; stale react ^18 peer ranges, verified React 19 safe. Remove once hds-react ships @react-spring/web >=10
